about_short_description.short_description: Lingo.dev automates localization by generating instant translations and creating pull requests with translations for UI code changes.

product.name: AI Localization Engine
product.description: Automates translations immediately upon code commits, ensuring high-quality results without manual intervention.

product.name: Git-native UI Localization
product.description: Localizes web and mobile user interfaces through Git, automating UI string updates via pull requests in CI/CD pipelines.

product.name: Lingo.dev CLI
product.description: A free, open-source command-line tool that helps developers translate apps and markdown content efficiently using LLMs.

product.name: Lingo.dev CI/CD
product.description: An open-source localization automation tool that integrates with CI/CD pipelines to prevent incomplete translations from reaching production.

product.name: Lingo.dev SDK
product.description: Lightweight libraries that add real-time AI-powered translation to applications, handling dynamic user-generated content.

product.name: Lingo.dev Compiler
product.description: A free, open-source compiler middleware that makes React applications multilingual at build time without changing existing components.
